name: open-steamgate
description: Local /IWBEP/ OData v2 runtime for classic code-based SEGW services: transpile ABAP, Open SQL over SQLite, serve Fiori

scripts.transpile: rm -rf output && node tools/cds2ddic.mjs && node tools/stg-compile.mjs --all && node tools/segw-registry.mjs && node tools/segw-shlp.mjs && abap_transpile
scripts.unit: npm run transpile && echo RUNNING && node --expose-gc output/index.mjs && echo OK
scripts.integration: mocha test/mocha.mjs test/analytics.mjs test/segw.mjs test/segw-gen.mjs test/rfc-replay.mjs test/rfc-live.mjs test/segw-shlp.mjs test/stg-compile.mjs test/segw-tree.mjs test/osd-store.mjs test/osd-xref.mjs test/osd-data.mjs test/osd-unit.mjs test/osd-git.mjs test/osd-runtime.mjs test/osd-proxy.mjs test/osd-persist.mjs test/adt-session.mjs test/adt-facade.mjs test/adt-devloop.mjs
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run unit && npm run integration
scripts.osd:serve: npm run transpile && STG_SERVE=child STG_PORT=8099 node test/run.mjs
scripts.unit:duckdb: npm run transpile && echo RUNNING on DuckDB && STG_DB=duckdb node --expose-gc output/index.mjs && echo OK
scripts.start:duckdb: npm run transpile && STG_DB=duckdb node test/run.mjs
scripts.e2e:preview: npm run web:preview && playwright test --config playwright.preview.config.mjs
